questions.question: Which selection ideas should the new research measure against history? (The existing bucket-rules replay can be included as the baseline.)

options.label: Diff since last green
options.description: Select against the tree of the last passing local gate, not the PR base. Review rounds touch few files, so most rounds should narrow even when the PR as a whole touched pyproject.toml or _backend.py. Measured from per-PR commit sequences on GitHub.

options.label: Step routing in `all`
options.description: Skip whole non-test steps (docs-build, notebooks, examples, check-links, typecheck) when the round touches nothing they read, and keep cheap fail-prone checks always on. Needs per-step wall times, which nobody has measured yet.

options.label: Failure-history ranking
options.description: Run first, or only within a time budget, the tests and checks that failed on similar diffs in CI red runs and transcripts. Good enough in a maintenance phase, where failures cluster in a few areas.

options.label: Bucket-rules replay
options.description: Replay the 2026-10-05 bucket rule set with Phase 0's harness as the comparison baseline. Cheap, because the harness exists.

questions.question: What should this session deliver?

options.label: Research + report (Recommended)
options.description: Mine PRs, commits, CI runs and transcripts, replay the chosen ideas, and write a report under sdd/research/ with a recommendation plus a BK-403 dossier update. Nothing is built into the gate yet.

options.label: Research, then prototype
options.description: As above, then build the winning selector as a script plus a hatch target (part of BK-404) in the same PR. Larger PR, faster to use.

options.label: Prototype directly
options.description: Skip the measurement and build the most plausible idea now, judged by using it. Fastest, but nothing shows it saves time.

questions.question: What bar should 'good enough' be for the local gate (the BK-408 question)?

options.label: Net time saved (Recommended)
options.description: Escapes are allowed; each one costs a full run, and the selector must still save time overall. CI's full gate on the merge head is the safety net. Matches bucket-rules.md.

options.label: Net saved + escape cap
options.description: As above, plus a hard cap, e.g. at most 1 in 20 rounds lets through a failure that CI then catches.

options.label: Zero escapes
options.description: Phase 0's merge-barrier bar. It has already stopped one design.

questions.question: Which skills should run `hatch run fast` before a round push instead of `hatch run all`? (This is BK-404's open decision; `all` stays the check before /pr and at /ship's close.)

options.label: /ship and /fix-pr rounds (Recommended)
options.description: Both skills that push review rounds use `fast`; /pr and /ship's close push keep `all`. The saving reaches every review loop, and BK-404 closes in this PR.

options.label: Only /fix-pr
options.description: /ship keeps `all` for every push. Smaller change, but /ship loops are where most rounds happen.

options.label: No skill edits yet
options.description: Ship the target for manual use only and leave BK-404 open until it has been used for a while.

questions.question: How should BK-403 leave this PR?

options.label: Close as done (Recommended)
options.description: A selector is chosen and built: replayed on 1,099 commits, it runs the full suite on 7% of rounds. Misses are judged in use under the net-time bar; a miss that recurs gets a FULL rule.

options.label: Keep in progress
options.description: Leave it `[~]` until a few weeks of use have counted misses (escapes), then decide.

questions.question: Where should 12 workers be set?

options.label: Your env var only (Recommended)
options.description: Change your User-level `RS_TEST_WORKERS` from 8 to 12; no repo change. The launcher's own formula already gives 14 on this 20-CPU machine, measured 3% slower than 12.

options.label: Change launcher default
options.description: Lower the launcher's CPU factor so 20 CPUs yield 12. This affects every machine, and the measurements come from this one box only.
